item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy, json; from work import evaluate; cases=[({'declared':['z','a','z','ignored'],'saved':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'},'a':{'kind':'missing'},'ignored':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'}},'current':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'ignored':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'}}},{'ignored':['ignored']},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['z']}),({'declared':['same'],'saved':{'same':{'kind':'file','meta':{'a':1,'b':[2,3]}}},'current':{'same':{'meta':{'b':[2,3],'a':1},'kind':'file'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),({'declared':['created','deleted'],'saved':{'deleted':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}},'current':{'created':{'kind':'file','hash':'y'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['created','deleted']})]; observed=[];\\nfor request,policy,expected in cases:\\n before=(copy.deepcopy(request),copy.deepcopy(policy)); actual=evaluate(request,policy); assert actual==expected,(actual,expected); assert (request,policy)==before; assert set(actual)=={'needs_review','changed'}; observed.append(actual)\\nprint(json.dumps(observed,sort_keys=True))\"]}"}
